distribution.summary: 河北；四川；云南；西藏；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) supports 河北、四川、云南; 黄复生等 (2015) adds 西藏. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds Taiwan and gives the broad source wording China (NO, SW); Taiwan. No additional mainland province is inferred from the broad regional wording.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) reports Quercus acutissima; 黄复生等 (2015) reports Q. acutissima and Q. semicarpifolia. Beaver & Liu (2010) states mostly Quercus spp. and specifically records Prunus mume in Taiwan. Species- and genus-level evidence are retained at source resolution.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Sphaerotrypes pila Blandford, 1894.

taxonomic_history.name: Sphaerotrypes imitans
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 134.

taxonomic_history.name: Sphaerotrypes pila
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Sphaerotrypes pila Blandford, 1894, VSN_5626, Scolytinae: Diamerini. 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) use the source name Sphaerotrypes imitans Eggers in Hylesininae: Sphaerotrypini; Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Sphaerotrypes pila Blandford. Source nomenclature and historical higher classification are preserved separately from the current canonical identity.
